授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
A large number of  laws of physics are expressed in terms of rates of change of continuous quantites.
When those quantities depend on more than one variable those rates of change are partial derivatives,
and the governing laws become partial differential equations. Examples include fluid dynamics,
electromagnetism, heat and diffusion, acoustics and wave phenomena and so on.
This course aims to furnish the student with the ability to mathematically formulate problems which
can be expressed as partial differential equations, understand the type of the equation, select
appropriate solution techniques (analytical or numerical as appropriate), and solve the problem to extract
the desired engineering information.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: partial differential equations, Fourier series, numerical solution, finite-difference method, spectral methods
